releaseNotes: The Now Batting banner is now a solid navy bar with white text so it stands out from the rest of the game card. Pressing Play Music now starts with a stadium-style announcer voice saying 'Now batting, number N, Name' for whoever is actually at bat (number and name come from the roster automatically), with a PA-system echo, and then the walk-up music plays. Stop still stops everything, and the announcement plays at the phone's volume, independent of the in-app sounds setting.
